text:
anna_ml: quick heads-up — ran a 10k-sample GTN chat slice comparing sirocco-8B-int6 vs zephyr-13B-int8. short summary below, full logs in the eval bucket.
kai_infra: can you drop the numbers? especially cost per 1M tokens and 95p latency.
anna_ml: sure. paste of the aggregated metrics: ```\nmodel                cost_per_1M_tokens   95p_latency_ms   throughput_tok_s   multi_turn_coh_delta
sirocco-8B-int6      $85                 210              120                -4.2%
zephyr-13B-int8      $210                340               80                +1.1%
```\nanna_ml: notes — sirocco is ~2.5x cheaper but shows a regression on our multi-turn coherence metric (the -4.2% is vs baseline nova-7b-int4). zephyr is slightly better than baseline on coherence but costs more and has worse tail latency.
eval-bot: full eval artifacts: gs://redwood-evals/slices/gtn_chat/3034567890/ (models, prompts, diff reports)
sam_prod: product impact? if multi-turn coherence drops we might see more user churn on long chat sessions.
maria_research: did you check hallucination on entity prompts? quant can blow up rare-entity grounding.
anna_ml: yes, ran an entity-focused ablation. quick snippet: ```\nmetric         sirocco-8B-int6   zephyr-13B-int8
entity-f1       0.82              0.85
fact-precision  0.78              0.86
```\nmaria_research: that's notable — sirocco drops on precision. could be quant noise or tokenization interaction.
kai_infra: what's the latency distribution for short vs long requests? i.e., 1-20 tokens vs 200-600.
anna_ml: short requests (median len 12): sirocco 140ms median, 95p 190ms. zephyr median 220ms, 95p 320ms. long requests (avg 320 tokens): sirocco median 340ms, 95p 520ms (cache hit behavior worse). zephyr median 530ms, 95p 720ms.
sam_prod: so tradeoff = cheaper and faster tail for sirocco but worse correctness on multi-turn and entity precision. product would prefer keeping coherence for paid customers.
maria_research: hypothesis — int6 quantization for sirocco induces subtle context-collapse over long KV cache sequences. we should AB test with int8 quant for the same model; might regain ~2-3% coherence at +15% cost.
anna_ml: ran a quick int8 sample on sirocco: cost_up ~+18% (to $100/1M), coherence_delta moves from -4.2% to -1.3%, entity-precision from 0.78 to 0.81.
kai_infra: proposed operational playbook: route short, high-volume queries to sirocco-8B-int6 for cost savings; route long/multi-turn sessions (>=5 turns or >200 tokens) to zephyr-13B-int8 or sirocco-int8 if we enable it for selected buckets. fallback rules if coherence < threshold.
sam_prod: can we express that as simple routing flags for GTN? e.g., feature flag: routing_policy=hybrid_sirocco_zephyr -> route_by_turn_count + user_tier overrides.
anna_ml: yes. suggested rollout: start 10% traffic beta, only non-paid users. collect coherence delta and NPS proxy. 48h smoke and then expand.
maria_research: also add entity precision checks to the smoke. if entity-precision drops >1.5% rollback.
eval-bot: created automated alert: alert://eval/coherence-delta > 2% for 30m -> paging-devops
kai_infra: ops note — we need to pre-warm sirocco KV caches for long sessions otherwise its long-request latency will spike; add small warmup burst during rollout.
sam_prod: ok let's do the 10% non-paid rollout with logging and rollback thresholds. anna can you own the eval gating? @kai_infra take the prewarm script? @maria_research own entity checks?
anna_ml: on it. i'll post the rollout PR and the gating dashboard.
kai_infra: i'll add prewarm command to the deployment pipeline and a small autoscale tweak for initial burst.
maria_research: i'll add entity-focused evals and the regression tests to ci-evals.
sam_prod: thanks team. :thumbsup:
anna_ml: next update in ~24h with the first 10% metrics.
